content.value_statement: Market teams need structured reports that combine research, visuals, and strategic frameworks. This skill guides research, LaTeX writing, visual generation, and quality review.
actual_capabilities: Defines report scope, geography, market boundaries, and key research questions.
Gathers market size, competitor, trend, and regulatory inputs through research-lookup prompts.
Applies TAM/SAM/SOM, Porter, PESTLE, SWOT, BCG, and positioning frameworks.
Generates core report visuals through scientific-schematics and generate-image workflows.
Uses LaTeX templates and style assets for long-form business reports.
Provides checklists for PDF compilation, bibliography, figures, and quality review.
limitations: It requires external research tools and visual-generation skills for the full workflow.
It does not verify paid market data unless users provide reliable sources.
Generated market numbers need citation checks before business decisions.
The visual script assumes local sibling skills and may need path fixes.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Industry Brief
use_cases.description: Build a structured report on market size, trends, competitors, risks, and recommendations.

use_cases.title: Assess a Market Entry
use_cases.description: Compare regions, segments, competitors, and barriers before launching a product.

use_cases.title: Support Investment Diligence
use_cases.description: Create a cited market view with sizing assumptions, scenarios, and risk analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Report Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a market research report outline for [market]. Define scope, geography, audience, key questions, and required visuals.

prompt_templates.title: Build Market Sizing
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [market] size and growth. Build TAM, SAM, and SOM estimates with assumptions, sources, and sensitivity notes.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Competition
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the competitive landscape for [market]. Include top competitors, Porter forces, positioning, market share, barriers, and risks.

prompt_templates.title: Produce Full Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full market research report for [market]. Generate visuals, cite sources, write LaTeX sections, compile the PDF, and review quality.

output_examples.input: Create a market overview for electric vehicle charging infrastructure in North America.
output_examples.output: A scoped market overview with ecosystem roles, growth drivers, key segments, source needs, and recommended visuals.

output_examples.input: Analyze competitors in cloud data warehouse platforms.
output_examples.output: A competitive section with market share themes, Porter analysis, positioning axes, barriers, and strategic implications.

output_examples.input: Prepare an investment thesis for renewable energy storage.
output_examples.output: A diligence-ready thesis with market sizing, growth scenarios, risks, opportunities, and prioritized recommendations.

best_practices: Define market boundaries before collecting data or generating visuals.
Cite every market statistic and document projection assumptions.
Review generated visuals and LaTeX output before sharing the report.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated numbers as verified market data.
Do not skip source review for investment or legal decisions.
Do not publish reports with placeholder competitors, figures, or citations.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates long-form market research reports with analysis frameworks, visuals, citations, and LaTeX formatting.

faq.question: Does it gather current market data?
faq.answer: It guides research through research-lookup prompts. Users must verify sources and dates.

faq.question: Can it generate charts and diagrams?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes workflows for scientific-schematics and generate-image visual creation.

faq.question: Is the output ready for board use?
faq.answer: It needs human review, source validation, and formatting checks before executive distribution.

faq.question: Which frameworks are supported?
faq.answer: It covers TAM/SAM/SOM, Porter, PESTLE, SWOT, BCG, positioning, risk, and opportunity frameworks.

faq.question: Does it compile the final PDF?
faq.answer: It provides LaTeX compilation steps. Local TeX tooling must be installed separately.
